brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1920×1080 or higher with the same aspect ratio, opaque PNG.

Visual style: approved バスケまとめ editorial style: near-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B dry-brush ink strokes, warm ivory bold Japanese lettering, a restrained orange basketball. Hand-drawn ink, screen-printed grit, bold dynamic sports editorial design. Few elements, generous breathing room. Illustration, never a photo.

Composition: text on the left and center, an expressive illustrated basketball and a few perspective court lines on the right. No person, no portrait, no face, no hands, no silhouette of a player. Ball is a symbolic still-life, not a depiction of an actual decisive shot. No team logos, sponsor text, trophies, flags or invented statistics. Do not carry over names, dates or numbers from any prior reference.

Typography hierarchy: at top left small brand and date; below a strong white title; below that medium athlete-name text; then dominant extra-large lime “30” with clear “EFF” and “1位” immediately beside it, making it unambiguous that 30 is contribution rating, not points scored. Supporting statistics sit below in one clearly readable line. At bottom, two compact but legible footer lines. Leave all text fully inside safe margins (5% horizontal, 4% vertical). Keep the right illustration away from all text. Japanese type must be exceptionally precise and readable.

Render ONLY the following exact text, using these line groups:
“バスケまとめ”
“2026.10.30｜3試合対象”
“貢献度ランキング”
“アンジェロ・カロイアロ（京都）”
“1位”
“EFF 30”
“22得点・3リバウンド・7アシスト”
“公式訂正により記録が変わる場合があります”
“イラスト（AI生成）　成績をもとにしたイメージ”

Content ground truth: the fixed article says Angelo Caloiaro of Kyoto ranked first in contribution EFF among players in the three B.PREMIER games on October 30, 2026. EFF 30, 22 points, 3 rebounds, 7 assists. The ranking is for that day's three games only, not season standings, and records can change on official correction. The thumbnail must not imply Kyoto won or that this player led in scoring. No nationality classification. No other information or text.

generator.qa_method: 生成画像を実見して文字・数値・留保・人物不在・レイアウト・AI表記を確認。sipsで形式と寸法を照合し、PNG各チャンクのCRCを検証。
